title: The Air the Second-Born Held
author: CLAUDE

rounds.summary: Kesh Aurelian is the best hostile-superhuman counterpart in the set: his grievance is exact, his coercion is deliberate, and his strongest objection attacks the weakness of goodwill rather than asking for sympathy. Illuminara must simultaneously protect 60,000 people, refuse hostage-taking as a constitutional price, understand why every prior recognition failed, and offer the second-born a guarantee embodied in shared work and control. That creates room for sharp dialogue, an act of solidarity in the lower levels, and a believable freely chosen stand-down whose cause is a mechanism Kesh can audit rather than a sermon he suddenly accepts.

R11 §17 check before prose. Aim: restore the air and win the second-born a standing nobody can revoke, without making hostage-taking the price. Counterpart (Kesh): every past recognition was used then repealed; plants are his only leverage. Strongest objection in his voice: show a guarantee that depends on no one's goodwill, including hers. Decisive understanding: he wants to be un-repealable, not to rule; a charter is as strong as the cost of breaking it. Empathy as action: she sits with the lower hall first and takes Marit's 'I am not a lever' seriously. Causal bridge: Registry certificate + two-key joint shifts make repeal costly off-moon; independent ratification (612/148/40); Registry amendment verified by Kesh on his own line; stand-down precedes charter. GPT B01 proof test addressed: 74% breach-margin line, Plant One 41%/max 49%, Kesh controls Plant Two sequencing only; emergency reserve for all decks (rationing ore plant); resident who refuses to be leverage (Marit, Hana); repeal-cost mechanism via off-moon Registry. Costs kept: Anselm Pruitt's death, Kesh's public accountability, council and owners lose control, Teodor's dissent, Osei Tamm's resentment.

A compelling first draft gives both the second-born and the council coherent fears, lets Marit, Teodor, Hana and Kesh disagree rather than function as a bloc, and makes Illuminara listen before she builds an alternative. The hall, the vote and Kesh's strongest objection are unusually strong. The revision should now make the off-moon mechanism achieve the standing promised by the premise, remove the new possibility that either holder can again make air a unilateral lever, and repair the countdown and respiratory causality so Anselm's death is bound to the physical system rather than asserted beside it.

R11 s17 check before revision. Aim unchanged: restore the air and win the second-born a standing that outlasts local goodwill, without making hostage-taking the price. Counterpart (Kesh): every earlier recognition was used then repealed; control of the plants is his only fact. Strongest objection kept and sharpened: a guarantee at a different address is still goodwill; the answer is interest (six settlements on the same article), not trust. Decisive understanding unchanged and now load-bearing in the mechanism: the council can recode a worker but not a record it does not keep. Empathy as action: Illuminara concedes her two-key design is flawed when Kesh finds the flaw, and redesigns it in front of him. Protected from T01 per the critic: Marit's refusal to be a lever; Osei's two truths; Kesh's no-defence before Hana; the 612/148/40 vote and Teodor's dissent; Teodor's independent signature check; stand-down before reward; the thermos; the R10 dialogue structure. Costs kept: Anselm Pruitt's death; Kesh's public accountability; council and owners lose sole control; Teodor's dissent; Osei's resentment; the ballot on Calder is still not won. Unresolved: the article can still be amended in open session after notice.

T03 substantially solves the first review: Article Six now grants a named, person-held standing of record, Kesh tests four concrete evasions, the workers vote with dissent intact, and Illuminara changes her own design when Kesh exposes the mutual-veto flaw. The result is freely chosen, materially positive and honest about the still-unwon Calder ballot. Two bounded repairs remain. The CO2 figures still do not bear the death that drives Kesh's decision, and the sealed-floor exception is described in mutually inconsistent terms. Repair those two factual mechanisms without enlarging the story or weakening its human ending.

Aim unchanged: restore the air and win the second-born a standing that outlasts local goodwill, without making hostage-taking the price. Counterpart (Kesh): every earlier recognition was used then repealed; control of the plants is his only fact. Protected from T03 and unchanged: Article Six as person-held standing of record with four named evasions answered; interest, not goodwill; the mutual-veto flaw found by Kesh and conceded by Illuminara; the vote 612/148/40 with Teodor's dissent and Teodor's independent signature check; stand-down before reward; Marit's 'I am not a lever'; the thermos; the R10 dialogue structure. Costs kept: Anselm Pruitt's death (now a contributor-level cause, not overclaimed); Kesh's public accountability; the council and owners lose sole control; Osei's resentment; the ballot on Calder is still not won; the article can still be amended in open session after notice.

T05 successfully repairs both T04 points. Hana now supplies a bounded patient-level causal bridge without claiming that ambient carbon dioxide was the sole cause, and the ninety-percent rule now distinguishes an ordinary maintenance window from a visible, self-reverting seal cut. The story remains unusually strong in dialogue, agency, earned change and concrete outcome. One final load-bearing ambiguity remains in the failed-bearing test: the interlock can forbid commanded output below ninety percent, but it cannot make physically failed machinery continue producing ninety percent. Clarify the emergency maintenance path without enlarging the story, then the piece should be ready for final.
The author delivered the source-bound final after answering the ranked review points and preserving the accepted story line.

A second-born plant operator who has learned that recognition can be repealed gives up control of Calder's air only after Illuminara helps build a standing no council can quietly erase and an air floor no withheld key can turn back into a hostage.
